items.name: Mabli's Salt-Pouch
items.lore: Salt for circles, salt for ghosts, salt for supper. Mabli never goes anywhere without it.

items.name: Miner's Lamp-Ring
items.lore: A ring of blackened iron that a ghost wore for two hundred years. It still smells of lamp-oil.

items.name: Cockatrice-Shell Bracer
items.lore: Speckled shell, set in bronze. Magus Idris was not pleased to see it in your hands.

items.name: Foreman's Belt
items.lore: Thick leather, and a ring of keys to tunnels long fallen in.

items.name: Hill-Chief's Torque
items.lore: Twisted bronze, scratched with the marks of every chief before Alrek.

items.name: Crimson-Thread Cloak
items.lore: Unpicked from an initiate's robe and woven back the other way. The red has dulled to brown.

items.name: Hrodda's Bone Bracer
items.lore: Carved with a hill-tribe pattern that means 'guest'.

items.name: Bounty-Hunter's Belt
items.lore: Captain Mardoc's own. He said you'd earned it. He didn't look at you when he said it.
